dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you an ascended musician, then?

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: Indeed, that is so. A flawless body, immortal life, and absolute beauty. Behold, citizen. You look upon the honor bestowed on me by the Sebastos.

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: He has caused our bodies to transcend lowly mortality, turning the tragic dirge of death into proud triumph.

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: It is by this grace that I have the honor of performing the eternal symphony.
